note: Ps44 national lament (corrected method). Human IB: batach trust (not in bow), halal boast in God + yadah thanks, protest of innocence (shakach not-forgotten, shaqar not-false to covenant, lev heart not turned), shame-state (cherpah/kelimmah/bosheth), chashab regarded as slaughter-sheep, oni affliction, nefesh bowed to dust. ~14 God-acts (drove/saved/rejected/disgraced/broke/hides/forgets/redeems/chesed) = qualifiers. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: negated ('NOT in my bow do I trust')

'For not in my bow do I TRUST (batach), nor can my sword save me' — reliance placed on God, not weapons; batach (recurs Ps20:7 chariots-vs-name) the trust disowned from bow and sword and given to God who saves
'you have put to shame those who HATE (sane) us' — the foes defined by their hatred; sane (recurs Ps41) the enemies God once shamed, whose renewed triumph the lament laments (v10)
grounded in God's past saving deeds (v7)

'In God we have BOASTED (halal) continually' — the nation's habitual glorying in God; halal (recurs Ps34:2) the boasting grounded in God's past deeds (drove out nations, saved us — the qualifiers), the confidence now tested by rejection
'and we will GIVE THANKS (yadah) to your name forever' — the vow of perpetual praise; yadah the thanksgiving joined to boasting, the nation's settled devotion before the lament's turn
hate (sane - those who hate us got spoil)
'those who HATE (sane) us have gotten spoil' — the haters now plundering; sane here the foes triumphant after God made the nation turn back, the reversal from v7

'You have made us the TAUNT (cherpah) of our neighbours' — the nation reduced to an object of reproach; cherpah (recurs Ps22:6, 39:8) the disgrace of the once-boasting people, derided and scorned by those around
paired with shame covering the face

'All day long my DISGRACE (kelimmah) is before me' — the humiliation constantly in view; kelimmah the shame the nation carries, its source God's rejecting and disgracing (v9 qualifier), the taunter and reviler its occasion
'and SHAME (bosheth) has covered my face' — shame as a veil over the countenance; bosheth (recurs Ps35:26) the disgrace that covers the face at the sound of the taunter and reviler (v16)
paired with not being false to covenant

'All this has come upon us, though we have not FORGOTTEN (shakach) you' — the protest of innocence: undeserved suffering despite fidelity; shakach negated, the nation insisting it has not abandoned God — the anguish of the faithful afflicted
be false / deal falsely (shaqar - to your covenant, negated)
negated ('we have NOT been false to your covenant')

'and we have not been FALSE (shaqar) to your covenant' — covenant fidelity maintained under affliction; shaqar negated, the nation's faithfulness to God's covenant, the ground of its bewildered protest
negated ('Our heart has NOT turned back')

'Our HEART (lev) has not turned back, nor have our steps departed from your way' — the inner constancy of the afflicted nation; lev the heart that stayed true despite suffering, the seat of the unwavering fidelity the psalm protests
forget (shakach - if we had forgotten God)

'If we had FORGOTTEN (shakach) the name of our God or spread our hands to a foreign god' — the hypothetical apostasy the nation denies; shakach (recurs v17) here the imagined betrayal that would have justified judgement — but God who knows the heart would have found them true
known by God who searches it (v21)

'would not God discover this? For he knows the secrets of the HEART (lev)' — the heart open to God's searching; lev here the inmost self whose secrets God knows (God's knowing = the qualifier) — the nation stakes its innocence on divine omniscience of the heart
be regarded / reckoned (chashab - as sheep for slaughter)
for your sake, all day long

'for your sake we are killed all the day long; we are REGARDED (chashab) as sheep to be slaughtered' — suffering endured FOR God's sake; chashab here the passive reckoning of the faithful as slaughter-victims — the mystery of the righteous afflicted (cited Rom8:36)
unrelieved while God hides his face and forgets (v24)

'Why do you forget our AFFLICTION (oni) and oppression?' — the misery God seems to ignore; oni (recurs Ps25,31) the nation's affliction, unrelieved while God hides his face and forgets (v24 qualifiers) — the anguished 'why?' of the faithful sufferer
soul (nefesh - bowed down to the dust)
appeals to God's redeeming steadfast love (v26)

'For our SOUL (nefesh) is bowed down to the dust; our belly clings to the ground' — the nation's self prostrate in the lowest humiliation; nefesh here the collective soul in the dust, from which it cries 'Rise up, redeem us for the sake of your steadfast love!' (v26 = the qualifier)
afflict / do harm (ra'a - God's act, past)
among God's past deeds the nation boasts of (v2->v8)

v2 QUALIFIER (God's past act): 'you AFFLICTED (ra'a) the peoples, but them you set free' - God's dealing with the nations is not a human IB char; part of the past deeds the nation boasts in (278850). Qualifier.
the favour behind the past victories the nation boasts of

v3 QUALIFIER (God's favour): 'your right hand... for you DELIGHTED (ratsah) in them' - God's delight in the fathers is not a human IB char; the favour behind their victories, boasted of (278850). Qualifier.
the salvation the King grants, ground of boasting
v4 QUALIFIER (God's salvation): 'You are my King, O God; ordain SALVATION (yeshuah) for Jacob!' - God's salvation is not a human IB char; the deliverances the nation boasts in (278850). Qualifier.
the salvation the nation boasts in (v7->v8)
v7 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'But you have SAVED (yasha) us from our foes' - God's saving is not a human IB char; the deed grounding the nation's boast (278850). Qualifier.
put to shame (bosh hiphil - God's act, past)
God shaming the foes, ground of boasting
v7 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'and have PUT TO SHAME (bosh) those who hate us' - God's shaming of the foes is not a human IB char; part of the past deeds boasted (278850). Qualifier.
God's rejecting behind the nation's disgrace (v9->v15)
v9 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'But you have REJECTED (zanach) us and disgraced us' - God's rejecting is not a human IB char; the source of the nation's disgrace (278722). Qualifier.
God's disgracing behind the nation's shame (v9->v15)
v9 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'and DISGRACED (kalam) us and have not gone out with our armies' - God's disgracing is not a human IB char; the cause of the nation's humiliation (278722). Qualifier.
God's breaking behind the nation's affliction (v19->v24)
v19 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'yet you have BROKEN (dakah) us in the place of jackals' - God's crushing is not a human IB char; the source of the nation's affliction (278788). Qualifier.
know (yada - God knows the heart's secrets)
God's searching knowledge of the heart (v21)

v21 QUALIFIER (God's knowledge): 'For he KNOWS (yada) the secrets of the heart' - God's omniscience of the heart is not a human IB char; it is the searching that vindicates the nation's innocent heart (302640). Qualifier.
the rejecting the nation begs God to end (v23->v24)

v23 QUALIFIER (God's act, deprecated): 'Awake! Why are you sleeping? Do not REJECT (zanach) us forever!' - God's rejecting is not a human IB char; what the afflicted nation begs God to cease (grounding its affliction, 278788). Qualifier.
God's hidden face behind the unrelieved affliction (v24)
v24 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'Why do you HIDE (sathar) your face?' - God's hiding is not a human IB char; the withdrawal behind the nation's unrelieved affliction (278788). Qualifier.

v24 QUALIFIER (God's act, felt): 'Why do you FORGET (shakach) our affliction?' - God's (felt) forgetting is not a human IB char; the divine inattention the nation laments (grounding its affliction, 278788). Qualifier.
the rescue the bowed soul appeals for (v26)
v26 QUALIFIER (God's act sought): 'Rise up; come to our help! REDEEM (padah) us' - God's redeeming is not a human IB char; the rescue the dust-bowed soul cries for (278791). Qualifier.
the ground of the appeal for redemption (v26)

v26 QUALIFIER (God's chesed): 'Redeem us for the sake of your STEADFAST LOVE (chesed)!' - God's covenant love is not a human IB char; the ground on which the bowed soul appeals for rescue (278791) - the psalm's final resting-place. Qualifier.
v13: 'the DERISION (laag) and scorn of those around us' - the mockery qualifying the nation's taunt-state (278714). Qualifier.
v13: 'the derision and SCORN (qeles) of those around us' - the scorn qualifying the taunt-state (278714). Qualifier.
v16: 'at the sound of the TAUNTER (charaph) and reviler' - the taunter whose voice occasions the nation's shame (278724). Qualifier.
v16: 'at the sight of the enemy and the AVENGER (naqam)' - the vengeful foe whose presence occasions the nation's shame (278724). Qualifier.
the covenant the nation stayed true to (278742)
v17: 'we have not been false to your COVENANT (berit)' - God's covenant, the bond the nation kept faith with (278742); the object of their fidelity. Qualifier.
hear (shama - we have heard, fathers told us)

v1: 'we have HEARD (shama) with our ears, our fathers have told us' - the nation's reception of the tradition of God's past deeds; the act of having-heard the fathers' testimony (grounds the recital, v2-3). Standalone.
save (yasha - their arm did not save, negated)

v3: 'nor did their own arm SAVE (yasha) them, but your right hand' - the fathers' strength that did NOT win the land; human self-salvation negated, the foil to God's saving hand (not the nation's inner operation but the disavowed self-reliance). Standalone.
save (yasha - my sword cannot save, negated)
v6: 'nor can my sword SAVE (yasha) me' - the disavowal of self-salvation by weapons, paired with the trust in God (278837); the sword's non-saving. Standalone (the IB is the trust, 278837).
name (shem - through your name we tread down)
v5: 'through your NAME (shem) we tread down those who rise up' - God's name as the power by which the nation prevails; a divine title/means, not a human inner operation. Standalone.
name (shem - give thanks to your name)
v8: 'we will give thanks to your NAME (shem) forever' - God's name, the object of thanksgiving (278852); a divine title, not an inner operation. Standalone.
v8: 'we will give thanks... FOREVER (olam)' - the perpetual duration of the thanksgiving (278852); a time-word, not an inner operation. Standalone.
v20: 'If we had forgotten the NAME (shem) of our God' - God's name, the object of the hypothetical forgetting (278761); a divine title, not an inner operation. Standalone.
